answer_1.quote: Query Focused Multi-Document Summarization (QFS; Dang 2006) aims to create a short summary from a set of documents that answers a specific query.

answer_4.quote: We also evaluated model summaries in a judgment elicitation study via Amazon Mechanical Turk. Native English speakers (self-reported) were asked to rate query-summary pairs on two dimensions: Succinctness ... and Coherence ... In addition, participants were asked to assess the Relevance of the summary to the query.
answer_4.guideline: Rate each summary on Relevance, Succinctness, and Coherence using a five point Likert scale.
